name: Taxes
overview: Scripture teaches that paying taxes is a matter of obedience and integrity, as seen when Jesus acknowledges the obligation to pay tribute to Caesar (Matthew 22:17) and instructs to give what is required without excess (Luke 3:13). The Old Testament also emphasizes lawful treatment regarding taxes, such as exemptions for God’s ministers (Ezra 7:24) and the prohibition against stealing (Exodus 20:15), underscoring that taxes should be justly imposed and paid. This biblical perspective balances respect for governing authorities with God’s standards of righteousness.
